slash_sword_shield.use: One-handed melee attack, for when there is melee. Its first frame is the combat stance.

stance_2h.use: Combat stance while wielding a two-handed weapon (once weapons pick their own stance).

draw_2h.use: Drawing a two-handed weapon from the back; played backwards it is sheathe_2h.

dig.use: Digging with a spade (a skilling action).

sit.use: Sitting on a chair or bench.

rest.use: Sitting on the ground to rest and regain run energy.

climb_into.use: Climbing into something: a pipe, a hole, a low gap (shortcuts).

talk.use: Talking to someone in a conversation.

idle_combat.use: Role: standing within 8 s of attacking or being hit. Held on the slash's first frame.

walk_combat.use: Role: walking within 8 s of attacking or being hit. No clip yet (suggested: Mixamo Sword And Shield Walk); the relaxed walk is used.

sheathe_2h.use: Role: putting a two-handed weapon away.

cast.use: Role: attacks and abilities (Occultism). No clip yet.

hit.use: Role: being hit. No clip: a small code-driven stagger is used, which suits Old School.

death.use: Role: dying (holds its last frame). No clip yet: the body topples backwards.
